info.title: BTCPay Server Plugin Builder API
info.description:
REST API for the BTCPay Server Plugin Builder. Provides endpoints for querying published plugin versions, downloading plugin binaries, checking for updates, and triggering new plugin builds.

The live server is available at [plugin-builder.btcpayserver.org](https://plugin-builder.btcpayserver.org/).

get.description: Returns the server's assembly version and git commit SHA.
Returns published plugin versions, optionally filtered by BTCPay Server version compatibility and plugin name. By default, only the latest version of each listed plugin is returned.

parameters.name: btcpayVersion
parameters.description: Filter by BTCPay Server version compatibility (e.g. `1.12.0`). When set to a version >= 2.1, only `listed` plugins are returned unless `searchPluginName` is also specified.

parameters.name: includePreRelease
parameters.description: Include pre-release versions.

parameters.name: includeAllVersions
parameters.description: When `true`, returns all versions for each plugin instead of only the latest.

parameters.name: searchPluginName
parameters.description: Search by plugin slug or name (case-insensitive partial match).

get.summary: Get a Directory plugin by slug
get.description: Returns the latest published version compatible with the requested BTCPay Server version for an exact Plugin Directory slug. Listed and unlisted plugins are available; hidden plugins are not returned.

parameters.name: pluginSlug
parameters.description: The exact plugin slug (e.g. `lnbank`).

parameters.name: btcpayVersion
parameters.description: Filter by BTCPay Server version compatibility.

parameters.name: includePreRelease
parameters.description: Include pre-release versions.

200.description: Latest compatible published version for the plugin

400.description: Invalid plugin slug or query parameter

404.description: Plugin not found or no compatible published version is available

get.summary: Get versions for a specific plugin
get.description: Returns all published versions for a specific plugin, identified by its plugin identifier (e.g. `BTCPayServer.Plugins.LNbank`).

parameters.name: identifier
parameters.description: The plugin identifier (e.g. `BTCPayServer.Plugins.LNbank`).

parameters.name: btcpayVersion
parameters.description: Filter by BTCPay Server version compatibility.

parameters.name: includePreRelease
parameters.description: Include pre-release versions.

parameters.name: includeAllVersions
parameters.description: When `true`, returns all versions instead of only the latest.

200.description: List of published versions for the plugin

parameters.name: version

post.description: Given a list of installed plugins with their current versions, returns the latest available versions. Useful for BTCPay Server instances to check if updates are available.

parameters.name: includePreRelease

AdminToken.description: Revocable admin access token issued in Account Settings. Admin API only; token management requires Basic auth.

Basic.description: HTTP Basic Authentication using your Plugin Builder login email and password. Format: `Authorization: Basic {base64(email:password)}`. Requires HTTPS in production.

btcpayMinVersion.description: Effective minimum compatible BTCPay Server version.

btcpayMaxVersion.description: Effective maximum compatible BTCPay Server version.

pluginLogo.description: URL of the plugin logo image.

documentation.description: URL to the plugin's public page on the Plugin Builder.

fingerprint.description: GPG fingerprint of the release signature, if signed.

downloadLink.description: Direct download URL for the build artifact.

published.description: Whether this build has been published as a release.

prerelease.description: Whether this is a pre-release version.

gitRef.description: Git branch or tag used for the build.

pluginDir.description: Plugin project directory within the repository.

buildHash.description: SHA-256 hash of the build artifact.

url.description: Download URL for the build artifact.

error.description: Build error message, if the build failed.

PluginManifest.description: Plugin manifest from the built assembly.

systemPlugin.description: Whether this is a system plugin.

CreateBuildRequest.description: Request to create a new plugin build. If fields are omitted, defaults from the plugin's settings are used.

gitRepository.description: Git repository URL. Required if not set in plugin settings.

gitRef.description: Git branch or tag (defaults to plugin settings or `master`).

pluginDirectory.description: Directory of the plugin project within the repository.

CreateBuildResponse.description: Response after successfully creating a build.

buildId.description: ID of the newly created build.

buildUrl.description: URL to view the build in the Plugin Builder web UI.

InstalledPluginRequest.description: Represents an installed plugin with its current version.
